protocol: Eight new questions plus four known controls; never pooled with failed F01-F12. Alternate baseline then candidate per question. Separate initially empty caches, shared cumulative refusal ledger. Runtime receives only question/language. No code, gold or prompts changed after freeze. Own source-first assessment, not independent review.
quality_gate: No new false/unknown-as-cited claims, no loss of baseline-supported requested conditions; unsupported API control preserved. Exact Unicode/provenance and source-scope binding required.
